about.heroSubtitle: Signature tours across Turkey's Aegean, Marmara, Black Sea, and Mediterranean coasts — from someone who truly lives this country.
about.storyParagraph1: For many years I have lived in Turkey, in sunny Izmir, and in that time I have truly discovered this amazing country. Together with my family, we travel across Turkey constantly, choosing not the standard routes but unique places known only to locals.
about.storyParagraph2: Before the pandemic I worked successfully in tourism. Today my professional experience, love of travel, and deep knowledge of the country have inspired me to create signature tours across the Aegean, Marmara, Black Sea, and Mediterranean coasts — with the food, history, and nature that rarely make it into classic itineraries.
about.storyParagraph3: I personally test the hotels, choose the restaurants, check the routes, and arrange the warmest welcome for our guests. You are accompanied by Russian-speaking guides, and my team is always nearby — so you can simply enjoy your trip, even if you don't speak English or Turkish.
about.quote: We don't sell tours — we create experiences that stay with you for a lifetime.
about.philosophyText: We don't drive along tourist routes. We reveal the real Turkey — through its people, nature, history, cuisine, and genuine hospitality.
